title: Department of Chemistry — Bachelor’s
summary: Studied organic synthesis, experimental design, and catalytic reaction optimization.
description: Conducted research under Prof. Chin-Fa Lee, a well-known scholar in organometallic catalysis and former department chair.
Focused on experimental design, organic synthesis, methodology development, and reaction optimization to identify effective catalytic systems.
Processed and visualized analytical data using Origin and MATLAB, including results obtained from GC-MS and HPLC, for quantitative and qualitative chemical analysis.
Developed practical laboratory skills in synthesis planning, catalyst evaluation, reaction monitoring, and scientific data interpretation.
responsibilities: Plan and conduct organic synthesis and catalyst-evaluation experiments.
Monitor reactions and analyze GC-MS and HPLC results.
Process, visualize, and interpret experimental data with Origin and MATLAB.
highlights: Applied experimental design and method development to catalytic reaction optimization.
Built a foundation in structured investigation, quantitative analysis, and scientific communication.
